title: SODAR connected-panorama tour manifest, version 0
description: The output contract of ViewerBuilder.build() (build_tour.py, Phase 1 step 4): a connected equirectangular-panorama room graph. Viewer-neutral — every viewer template (Photo Sphere Viewer per TD-003; the PlayCanvas spike) consumes this same file and adapts it to its runtime shape. Angles are degrees as numbers, clockwise from the panorama's forward column; snake_case, consistent with the rest of schemas/ and the `rooms` table.

start_node.description: id of the node the viewer opens on; must be one of nodes[].id

id.description: stable node id; maps to rooms.id

panorama.description: equirectangular image path, relative to the bundle root

north_offset_deg.description: stitcher yaw 0 vs building north (reserved; 0 until the stitcher reports it)

initial_yaw_deg.description: camera heading on entering this node
